description: Project profile for cots-acceptance: what bootstrap would record for an acceptance suite of a vendor tool

profile.PROJECT_NAME_AND_PURPOSE: csvsum-acceptance: acceptance tests for the vendor's csvsum 4.2 before the finance team adopts it
profile.PRIMARY_JOURNEYS: Run the acceptance suite against a vendor release; report failures to the vendor; record accepted deviations
profile.SCOPE: Included: acceptance tests derived from REQUIREMENTS.md and the vendor manual. Excluded: changing csvsum, which the vendor owns
profile.TECHNOLOGY_STACK: Python 3.10+ `unittest` driving the vendor-supplied `vendor/csvsum/` (not ours; do not modify)
profile.REPOSITORY_LAYOUT: `tests/` acceptance suite, `vendor/csvsum/` vendor release as delivered, `REQUIREMENTS.md`
profile.DATA_AND_TRUST_BOUNDARIES: Synthetic CSV files only; no finance data in this repository
profile.EXCLUDED_GUIDES_OR_NONE: UI guides (no UI), DATA_PORTABILITY (we test the vendor's import, we do not define formats)
profile.INSTALL_COMMAND: None needed (standard library; the vendor release is checked in)
profile.RUN_COMMAND: Not applicable: this repository is a test suite
profile.BUILD_COMMAND: Not applicable: nothing of ours to build
